verdict.rationale: CDP documents a guide to accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD and collect it in a treasury. Deposit destinations can act as liquidation addresses that convert incoming funds before crediting the account. Fiat settlement and bank payouts over ACH, Fedwire, Swift and SEPA cover the bank-payout path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-liquidation to fiat works end-to-end, and explicit detail on settlement timing and supported fiat currencies.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can take crypto payments but settle in fiat — a documented option to auto-convert stablecoin receipts into a fiat balance or bank payout so my books never hold crypto

citations.quote: Accept customer USDC, auto-convert it to USD, and collect it in your treasury, with the CDP CLI or SDK.
A destination can also act as a liquidation address, automatically converting incoming funds into a different asset before crediting the account.
Provision stable onchain addresses that auto-credit a custodial account, with optional auto-liquidation
Authorizations, captures, refunds, voids, disbursements, and fiat settlement
Send fiat out of a custodial account using ACH, Fedwire, Swift, or SEPA rails
